summary: Madhu uses Claude Opus 5.5 to create an interactive 3D domino playground in Claude Artifacts, featuring custom physics and interactive run controls.

post.originalText:
I asked Opus 5.5 to make a domino playground and it built this 🤯

Opus really is something! A full 3D interactive thingy. Tap any domino, watch the whole run fall, play with gravity and colours.

My first ever 3D interactable. Try it out here 👇
https://t.co/jKsDkGsfhT https://t.co/GqtU4zonUx

sourceMaterials.text: @BhagatDhanji Ikr. It’s super cool. I’m trying to do more with Claude and push it to its limits. I’ve seen much more crazy things from folks on X using Claude. I aspire to do something better next. For the physics part, Claude wrote its own code. Did not use any libraries
